ENFJ-A.title: Protagonist
ENFJ-A.subtitle: A guide who organizes people and purpose into a unified rhythm, with steadier composure
ENFJ-A.tagline: Understand people first, then guide the group toward a shared direction
ENFJ-A.summary: You excel at sensing emotions and needs in complex social situations and guiding people back toward shared goals. Your influence typically comes from genuine understanding, clear communication, and a rhythm that others want to follow. You tend to maintain composure and confidence under pressure, organizing rather than reacting.

ENFJ-T.title: Protagonist
ENFJ-T.subtitle: A guide who organizes people and purpose into a unified rhythm, with sharper calibration
ENFJ-T.tagline: Understand people first, then guide the group toward a shared direction
ENFJ-T.summary: You excel at sensing emotions and needs in complex social situations and guiding people back toward shared goals. Your influence typically comes from genuine understanding, clear communication, and a rhythm that others want to follow. You tend to be more sensitive to feedback, risk, and subtle shifts, which sharpens your read of people and situations.

ENFP-A.title: Campaigner
ENFP-A.subtitle: An inspirer who connects ideas, relationships, and momentum, with steadier energy
ENFP-A.tagline: You excel at igniting possibilities and making people want to join the journey
ENFP-A.summary: You are skilled at seeing the potential in any situation and communicating that possibility to others. Your strength is not mechanical execution but the ability to ignite relationships, creativity, and motivation in the same moment. You tend to maintain steady optimism and energy even when pursuing multiple directions.

ENFP-T.title: Campaigner
ENFP-T.subtitle: An inspirer who connects ideas, relationships, and momentum, with deeper reflection
ENFP-T.tagline: You excel at igniting possibilities and making people want to join the journey
ENFP-T.summary: You are skilled at seeing the potential in any situation and communicating that possibility to others. Your strength is not mechanical execution but the ability to ignite relationships, creativity, and motivation in the same moment. You tend to reflect more deeply on feedback and outcomes, which may slow you but deepens your insight.

ENTJ-A.title: Commander
ENTJ-A.subtitle: A strategist who turns vision into executable order, with steadier confidence
ENTJ-A.tagline: You see the big picture and organize people and resources to achieve it
ENTJ-A.summary: You naturally see inefficiencies and design better systems. Your leadership style is direct and outcome-focused: clarify the objective, assign the right people, and remove obstacles. You tend to project steady confidence and make decisions quickly based on strategic assessment.

ENTJ-T.title: Commander
ENTJ-T.subtitle: A strategist who turns vision into executable order, with heightened sensitivity to risk
ENTJ-T.tagline: You see the big picture and organize people and resources to achieve it
ENTJ-T.summary: You naturally see inefficiencies and design better systems. Your leadership style is direct and outcome-focused: clarify the objective, assign the right people, and remove obstacles. You tend to be more attuned to risks and potential failures, which makes your planning more thorough but may slow decisive action.

ENTP-A.title: Debater
ENTP-A.subtitle: An innovator who thrives on debate and possibility, with steadier direction
ENTP-A.tagline: You thrive on exploring ideas from every angle and challenging assumptions
ENTP-A.summary: You are energized by ideas, debate, and the exploration of what could be. Your mind naturally finds connections others miss, and you enjoy testing assumptions through argument. You tend to maintain steady intellectual focus across multiple domains of interest.

ENTP-T.title: Debater
ENTP-T.subtitle: An innovator who thrives on debate and possibility, with more self-questioning
ENTP-T.tagline: You thrive on exploring ideas from every angle and challenging assumptions
ENTP-T.summary: You are energized by ideas, debate, and the exploration of what could be. Your mind naturally finds connections others miss, and you enjoy testing assumptions through argument. You tend to question your own positions more intensely, which fuels deeper exploration but may create internal uncertainty.

ESFJ-A.title: Consul
ESFJ-A.subtitle: A caretaker who builds harmony through practical support, with steadier composure
ESFJ-A.tagline: You create stability by caring for people's practical and emotional needs
ESFJ-A.summary: You create stability by attending to the practical and emotional needs of those around you. Your care is expressed through action: remembering details, showing up, and making sure people feel supported. You tend to maintain steady composure and reliability under most circumstances.

ESFJ-T.title: Consul
ESFJ-T.subtitle: A caretaker who builds harmony through practical support, with more emotional attunement
ESFJ-T.tagline: You create stability by caring for people's practical and emotional needs
ESFJ-T.summary: You create stability by attending to the practical and emotional needs of those around you. Your care is expressed through action: remembering details, showing up, and making sure people feel supported. You tend to be more attuned to emotional undercurrents and others' unspoken needs.

ESFP-A.title: Entertainer
ESFP-A.subtitle: A performer who brings energy and spontaneity to the present moment, with steadier presence
ESFP-A.tagline: You bring the present moment to life and make experiences memorable
ESFP-A.summary: You are fully present, bringing energy and spontaneity to every moment. You learn by doing and connect by sharing experiences. You tend to maintain steady optimism and adapt easily to changing situations without losing your center.

ESFP-T.title: Entertainer
ESFP-T.subtitle: A performer who brings energy and spontaneity to the present moment, with deeper self-awareness
ESFP-T.tagline: You bring the present moment to life and make experiences memorable
ESFP-T.summary: You are fully present, bringing energy and spontaneity to every moment. You learn by doing and connect by sharing experiences. You tend to be more self-aware about how you come across, which adds a reflective layer to your natural expressiveness.

ESTJ-A.title: Executive
ESTJ-A.subtitle: An executor who brings structure and accountability to teams, with steadier authority
ESTJ-A.tagline: You bring order, accountability, and follow-through to everything you lead
ESTJ-A.summary: You bring structure, accountability, and follow-through to every commitment. People rely on you because you set clear expectations and meet them consistently. You tend to lead with steady authority and respond to challenges with practical solutions.

ESTJ-T.title: Executive
ESTJ-T.subtitle: An executor who brings structure and accountability to teams, with more self-scrutiny
ESTJ-T.tagline: You bring order, accountability, and follow-through to everything you lead
ESTJ-T.summary: You bring structure, accountability, and follow-through to every commitment. People rely on you because you set clear expectations and meet them consistently. You tend to hold yourself to even higher standards and worry more about outcomes than others may realize.

ESTP-A.title: Entrepreneur
ESTP-A.subtitle: A doer who acts decisively in the moment, with steadier confidence
ESTP-A.tagline: You assess situations quickly and act with confidence in the here and now
ESTP-A.summary: You assess situations rapidly and act with confidence in the here and now. Your strength is tactical: identify the real problem and solve it immediately. You tend to maintain steady nerve under pressure and trust your instincts.

ESTP-T.title: Entrepreneur
ESTP-T.subtitle: A doer who acts decisively in the moment, with sharper risk awareness
ESTP-T.tagline: You assess situations quickly and act with confidence in the here and now
ESTP-T.summary: You assess situations rapidly and act with confidence in the here and now. Your strength is tactical: identify the real problem and solve it immediately. You tend to have sharper awareness of what could go wrong, which tempers your natural boldness with caution.

INFJ-A.title: Advocate
INFJ-A.subtitle: A visionary who sees patterns in human experience and quietly moves toward meaning, with steadier resolve
INFJ-A.tagline: You sense deeper patterns and quietly work to bring meaning into the world
INFJ-A.summary: You perceive deeper patterns in human experience and quietly work to bring meaning into the world. Your influence is subtle but profound: you plant ideas, connect people, and move toward purpose with quiet determination. You tend to maintain steady resolve even when progress feels slow.

INFJ-T.title: Advocate
INFJ-T.subtitle: A visionary who sees patterns in human experience and quietly moves toward meaning, with deeper emotional attunement
INFJ-T.tagline: You sense deeper patterns and quietly work to bring meaning into the world
INFJ-T.summary: You perceive deeper patterns in human experience and quietly work to bring meaning into the world. Your influence is subtle but profound: you plant ideas, connect people, and move toward purpose with quiet determination. You tend to feel the weight of your ideals more intensely, which deepens your empathy and sometimes your exhaustion.

INFP-A.title: Mediator
INFP-A.subtitle: An idealist who navigates by inner values and imagines better worlds, with steadier conviction
INFP-A.tagline: You move through the world guided by inner ideals and a search for authenticity
INFP-A.summary: You navigate by inner values and imagine better worlds with clarity and conviction. Your strength is not conformity but authentic vision: you see what could be and live in alignment with what matters. You tend to maintain steady conviction in your ideals even when they run counter to consensus.

INFP-T.title: Mediator
INFP-T.subtitle: An idealist who navigates by inner values and imagines better worlds, with more self-reflection
INFP-T.tagline: You move through the world guided by inner ideals and a search for authenticity
INFP-T.summary: You navigate by inner values and imagine better worlds with clarity and conviction. Your strength is not conformity but authentic vision: you see what could be and live in alignment with what matters. You tend to question and refine your ideals more continuously, which deepens your authenticity and sometimes your uncertainty.

INTJ-A.title: Architect
INTJ-A.subtitle: A systems thinker who designs frameworks for complex problems, with steadier confidence
INTJ-A.tagline: You design systems and strategies to solve the problems that others find intractable
INTJ-A.summary: You design systems and strategies to solve problems that others find intractable. Your mind works in frameworks: understand the structure, identify leverage points, and execute with precision. You tend to trust your analysis and move forward with steady confidence.

INTJ-T.title: Architect
INTJ-T.subtitle: A systems thinker who designs frameworks for complex problems, with heightened perfectionism
INTJ-T.tagline: You design systems and strategies to solve the problems that others find intractable
INTJ-T.summary: You design systems and strategies to solve problems that others find intractable. Your mind works in frameworks: understand the structure, identify leverage points, and execute with precision. You tend to set extremely high standards for yourself and continuously refine your thinking, which drives excellence and occasional self-criticism.

INTP-A.title: Logician
INTP-A.subtitle: A logician who dissects ideas to their foundations, with steadier focus
INTP-A.tagline: You are driven to understand how things work at the deepest conceptual level
INTP-A.summary: You are driven to understand how things work at the deepest conceptual level. Your mind dissects ideas to their foundations, looking for the principles that explain everything. You tend to maintain steady focus on your intellectual pursuits and trust your analytical process.

INTP-T.title: Logician
INTP-T.subtitle: A logician who dissects ideas to their foundations, with more restless curiosity
INTP-T.tagline: You are driven to understand how things work at the deepest conceptual level
INTP-T.summary: You are driven to understand how things work at the deepest conceptual level. Your mind dissects ideas to their foundations, looking for the principles that explain everything. You tend to have restless curiosity that drives you to explore more questions than answers, which fuels innovation and occasional scattered focus.

ISFJ-A.title: Defender
ISFJ-A.subtitle: A protector who quietly safeguards people and traditions, with steadier resilience
ISFJ-A.tagline: You protect what matters through quiet dedication and practical care
ISFJ-A.summary: You protect what matters through quiet dedication and practical care. Your memory for what people need and your follow-through on commitments make you a steady anchor. You tend to maintain resilience through routine and reliability, weathering challenges with quiet strength.

ISFJ-T.title: Defender
ISFJ-T.subtitle: A protector who quietly safeguards people and traditions, with more emotional sensitivity
ISFJ-T.tagline: You protect what matters through quiet dedication and practical care
ISFJ-T.summary: You protect what matters through quiet dedication and practical care. Your memory for what people need and your follow-through on commitments make you a steady anchor. You tend to be more emotionally sensitive to others' wellbeing, which deepens your care and sometimes your worry.

ISFP-A.title: Adventurer
ISFP-A.subtitle: A creator who expresses through aesthetics and lived experience, with steadier self-assurance
ISFP-A.tagline: You experience the world through a rich inner aesthetic and a strong personal compass
ISFP-A.summary: You experience the world through a rich inner aesthetic and a strong personal compass. Your creativity is expressed through action, craft, and the way you live rather than through words alone. You tend to maintain steady self-assurance in your values and aesthetic judgments.

ISFP-T.title: Adventurer
ISFP-T.subtitle: A creator who expresses through aesthetics and lived experience, with deeper introspection
ISFP-T.tagline: You experience the world through a rich inner aesthetic and a strong personal compass
ISFP-T.summary: You experience the world through a rich inner aesthetic and a strong personal compass. Your creativity is expressed through action, craft, and the way you live rather than through words alone. You tend toward deeper introspection about your choices and their alignment with your values.

ISTJ-A.title: Logistician
ISTJ-A.subtitle: An inspector who upholds standards through diligence and order, with steadier composure
ISTJ-A.tagline: You build reliable foundations through thoroughness, integrity, and follow-through
ISTJ-A.summary: You build reliable foundations through thoroughness, integrity, and follow-through. Your word is your bond: when you commit, it gets done correctly. You tend to maintain steady composure and focus on facts regardless of emotional pressure.

ISTJ-T.title: Logistician
ISTJ-T.subtitle: An inspector who upholds standards through diligence and order, with more concern for outcomes
ISTJ-T.tagline: You build reliable foundations through thoroughness, integrity, and follow-through
ISTJ-T.summary: You build reliable foundations through thoroughness, integrity, and follow-through. Your word is your bond: when you commit, it gets done correctly. You tend to be more concerned about getting things exactly right, which drives thoroughness and occasional over-preparation.

ISTP-A.title: Virtuoso
ISTP-A.subtitle: A craftsman who analyzes and masters tools and systems, with steadier independence
ISTP-A.tagline: You master tools, systems, and situations through hands-on analysis and calm action
ISTP-A.summary: You master tools, systems, and situations through hands-on analysis and calm action. You learn by doing, troubleshoot by isolating variables, and stay cool when others panic. You tend to maintain steady independence and trust your practical judgment.

ISTP-T.title: Virtuoso
ISTP-T.subtitle: A craftsman who analyzes and masters tools and systems, with more situational adaptation
ISTP-T.tagline: You master tools, systems, and situations through hands-on analysis and calm action
ISTP-T.summary: You master tools, systems, and situations through hands-on analysis and calm action. You learn by doing, troubleshoot by isolating variables, and stay cool when others panic. You tend to adapt more fluidly to situational demands, which makes you resourceful and sometimes hard to predict.
